name: Weekly sprint report
description: Every week: reads the sprint from ClickUp, builds the team's sprint dashboard page and a short summary of points per project and person.
prompt: Sprint report for the week of {{today}}

params.label: Words in the sprint folder or list names

steps.task:
Prepare the sprint report as of {{today}} in {{language}}.

1. Call mcp__clickup__get_workspace and find the current sprint's lists (folder or list names containing: {{sprint_hint}}; one list per project folder). Call mcp__clickup__list_tasks for each of them. If the ClickUp tools are not available, stop and say that CLICKUP_TOKEN must be set.
2. Build the dashboard with the sprint-dashboard skill from these tasks (dashboards/sprint-{{today}}.html). Tasks that are not done stay not done: say how many in the footnote.
3. Write dashboards/summary-{{today}}.md: total and completed points, points per project and per person, tasks not finished, tasks without points or assignee, and three observations for the next sprint.
Use only what ClickUp returned; never guess points or people.
steps.successCriteria: dashboards/sprint-{{today}}.html and dashboards/summary-{{today}}.md built from ClickUp data
